- Ranking y second provides a strong backup, where I have high priority
- Ranking w third keeps an option with my top priority
- Ranking z last, as it's my least preferred and I have lower priority there

By ranking y second, I create a high probability backup
By ranking w third, I maintain a strategic alternative
By ranking z last, I minimize risk of an undesirable match
